shared_elements: carved stone surface in low/sunken relief
paired motifs arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis
repeated curved or chevron-like linear bands
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing shallow relief in which discs/rings and an oval enclosure sit on a central vertical axis flanked by paired repeated motifs, which is the most specific correspondence I can defend. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, pale rectangular slab with crisp, ruled columns of small legible sign-forms including a bird in profile, while B is a massive dark three-dimensional standing figure whose worn, rounded carvings follow the body's contours rather than any ruled grid.
